title: Open the current errors pop-up from the Overall System Aveva API page
summary: Use the “Get errors” control on the Overall System Aveva API page to open the pop-up that displays the current errors list.
when_to_use: When you need to view the current errors list from the Overall System Aveva API page.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Open the AVEVA HMI page labeled “Overall System Aveva API” and use the “Get errors” control to display the current errors pop-up.
